results.llm_raw: {"say":"No diagnosis; cut both visible miner feeds into L3 so the merged line delivers the required half-shape instead of full shapes.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$path_of":["B105","B97","B90"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"},{"kind":"trash","port":"right"}]},"why":"Insert cutter+trash on the M3-to-L3 run, keeping the left half."},{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$path_of":["B98","B91","B82"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"},{"kind":"trash","port":"right"}]},"why":"Insert cutter+trash on the other L3 input run so L3 sees only half-shapes."}]}

{"say":"Convert the cutter's left output belt into a rotater so its half-shape becomes the goal's top-row shape.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$path_of":["B84"]},"building":[{"kind":"rotater"}]},"why":"The cutter's left half needs a 90-degree rotation before reaching the hub."}]}

{"say":"Goal RuRu---- is a rotated half-shape: the factory has a cutter but no rotater at all, so add one on the cutter's left output belt so the half gets turned into the top-row shape before it flows on.","calls":[{"macro":"insert_machine","args":{"at":{"$ref":"B84","asCell":true},"facing":"top","machine":"rotater","opts":{"replace_belts":true}},"why":"C1's left output half must be rotated to become RuRu----; the build has no rotater, and this converts the existing output run in place so the rotated half continues down the line."}]}
